edits.old: Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003
edits.new:
Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003

  Scenario: AC5 Calculator answers fail (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the ACE Common contract mock returns an affordability result of fail
    When affordability is calculated
    Then R-RES-07 does not fire and the stage reports AFFORDABILITY_FAILED
    Then the parent applies R-RES-08 with reason affordability_failed and no offer is built

  Scenario: AC6 Record refused for a missing field (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the decision record is refused for a missing field
    When the action is taken
    Then nothing is written, the missing field is named and the stage stays where it was
    Then the incident names MSG-P7-009

  Scenario: AC7 Rule package not in force (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the RESTRUCTURE package is not in force or its checksum does not match
    When the affordability step runs
    Then EvaluateRules answers NoPackageInForce and the workflow does not retry
    Then the step does not call the calculator and MSG-GEN-006 is shown

  Scenario: AC8 Stale payoff figure (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the payoff figure on the case is stale
    When the affordability step runs
    Then MSG-S2-002 warns and a fresh figure is requested
    Then the calculator is not called until a figure inside the age is on the case

  Scenario: AC9 Second request while waiting (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given a second AFFORDABILITY_REQUIRED arrives while the branch is waiting on the calculator
    When the case signal arrives
    Then the inbox dedupes by the cloud event id and no second calculator call is made

edits.old: and the result is read there through the treatment read of RWB-S2-E3001-APP (DP-13).
edits.new: and the result is read there through the treatment read of RWB-S2-E3001-APP (DP-13). The step is started by rwb-case on the case signal, and by no Schedule and no batch trigger: the job map holds no S2 job and AceDataReady of rwb-source-data does not reach this service (GAP-1702). The screen states of SCR-14 and SCR-15 are: empty, with no affordability result on the treatment yet, so no plan and no offer are shown; loading, while the step waits on the calculator, so the stage AFFORDABILITY_IN_ACE is shown with no plan; error, when the treatment read fails, with the message code Not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-S2-E3005-APP-10); and no access, where a role without the right gets 403 and MSG-P4-002 (X5). Open decision DL10 is closed on the directive of 26 November 2026: its recommended resolution is accepted and the assumptions ASM-2250, ASM-2357, ASM-2377 and ASM-2863 are confirmed.
